text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara seems sluggish during
practice today.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wow... That cloud looks just like you,
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Right... Y'know, it's weird. Recently, I've
been
feeling heavy as a rock.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like it might be best to
rearrange her
race schedule...
